intro: Today's headlines highlight significant advancements in AI governance and research workflows. We also track the latest updates on autonomous vehicle testing for major industry players.

must_know.title: Frontier Model Forum updates
must_know.summary: The Frontier Model Forum, a coalition including OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and Microsoft, has appointed a new executive director and established a $10 million AI Safety Fund.
must_know.why_it_matters: This industry body aims to formalize safety standards and facilitate collaboration between major AI labs and policymakers.

must_know.title: Research acceleration: The view inside OpenAI
must_know.summary: OpenAI released internal data regarding the integration of coding agents into their research workflows, highlighting impacts on task complexity and experimentation speed.
must_know.why_it_matters: It offers insight into how AI developers are using autonomous agents to accelerate the research and development lifecycle.

must_know.title: TechCrunch Mobility: Tesla Cybercab hits the road — and a snag
must_know.summary: TechCrunch reports on early road testing for the Tesla Cybercab and subsequent challenges encountered by the autonomous platform.
must_know.why_it_matters: The performance of Tesla's dedicated robotaxi platform is a key indicator for the future of AI-driven autonomous transportation.
